method: Synthetic hive-mind: 5 worker votes derived from solution-sketches.md (recommendation = Sketch A + post-filter + __tests__/) + architect-review.md (APPROVED WITH 3 conditions) + security-review.md (APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS, 8 attack surfaces S1-S8).

votes.rationale: Sprint closes both load-bearing gaps documented by prior sprint (audit-resolution phase + scope-bounded workers) PLUS fixes the 10 HAR security findings. Single-cycle combined approach eliminates the dependency cycle (HAR fixes need scope-bound audit to verify; audit-resolution needs HAR fixes to demonstrate the resolve flow). v0.8.0 blockers cleared.

19 ACs is tight for a 14-day cycle but achievable because Wave 1 (~60 LOC) is small foundational work, Wave 3 HAR fixes are mostly S-effort (6 of 10), and Wave 4 is doc updates. Critical path: Wave 1 must land Day 3-4; Wave 2 phase infra Day 5-7; Wave 3 fixes can pair with Wave 2 walking the resolution against synthetic fixtures.
concerns: Wave 3 AC-10/AC-12 encryption is M-effort + needs migration path for legacy data; if legacy detection is bugged, breaks all existing memory.json/session.json files

votes.rationale: Architecture sound. Post-filter gate pattern (Sketch A + (a)) mirrors testgaps; AC-5 new phase requires 7-file update but recipe is documented. 3 conditions must hold by sprint-end: (1) audit-resolution exit predicate evaluable purely from state.json — no spec.md dep at exit, (2) sprint-audit-resolve.sh decisions atomically persisted so Ctrl-C resume is lossless, (3) sprint-audit-rerun.sh requires regression to appear TWICE consecutively before blocking (false-positive mitigation).
concerns: AC-5 phase exit-predicate complexity — the resolved+deferred+accepted=total math needs a new predicate kind in phase-predicates.sh
AC-6 interactive UX fragility — operator Ctrl-C mid-walk must resume idempotently
AC-10/AC-12 encryption key rotation — store keyVersion in encrypted payload for future migration

votes.rationale: 8 attack surfaces identified (S1-S8). All have mitigation owners mapped to specific ACs. APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS pending: (S1) encryption key file 0600 perms + crypto.randomBytes(32), (S2) sprint-audit-resolve.sh rationale piped through sprint-pii-redact.sh before atomic_update_state (mirror C5 from prior sprint), (S3) sprint-audit-rerun.sh wraps audit worker with `env -i HOME PATH SHELL` allowlist (mirror reuse-audit env-strip from .husky/post-commit:181), (S6) HAR-2/HAR-4 migration atomic — encrypted .tmp + O_EXCL + fsync + atomic_rename + delete plaintext only after rename success.
concerns: S1 key file generation must use crypto.randomBytes — NEVER Math.random or Date.now
S2 rationale text from operator can contain accidentally-pasted secrets — PII redaction mandatory
S6 migration partial-write would leave plaintext + encrypted both on disk = data leak vector

votes.rationale: Spec is sharp + builds directly on prior sprint's documented gaps. Per-wave commits + real proof files held up last sprint; same discipline expected here. C7-equivalent strengthening: dogfood walk in Wave 4 must verify state.audit_findings_resolved_count == audit_findings_total post-fix (i.e., the resolution pipeline actually drains).
concerns: W4 dogfood C7-equivalent should require empty state.audit_findings_deferred[] for this specific sprint (this sprint's audit should produce 0 in-scope findings — proving scope-bounding works AND no new vulns introduced)

outcome: PASS-WITH-CONDITIONS (5 votes: 2 pass + 3 pass-with-conditions/notes). Architect + security conditions must be addressed during the build, not bypassed.
ship_gate_conditions: C1 (architect): audit-resolution exit predicate purely state.json — no spec.md dependency at predicate eval time.
C2 (architect): sprint-audit-resolve.sh decisions atomically persisted; Ctrl-C resume reads state to skip already-decided findings.
C3 (architect): sprint-audit-rerun.sh requires regression detection TWICE consecutively before blocking (false-positive mitigation).
C4 (security): encryption key file 0600 perms + crypto.randomBytes(32) only — never Math.random/Date.now.
C5 (security): sprint-audit-resolve.sh rationale piped through sprint-pii-redact.sh before atomic_update_state.
C6 (security): sprint-audit-rerun.sh wraps audit worker invocation with `env -i HOME PATH SHELL` allowlist.
C7 (security): HAR-2/HAR-4 legacy-plaintext migration atomic (encrypted .tmp + O_EXCL + fsync + atomic_rename + delete plaintext only after rename succeeds).

C8 (reviewer): W4 dogfood proves state.audit_findings_resolved_count == audit_findings_total AND audit_findings_deferred[] is empty for this sprint (verifies scope-bounding eliminated noise AND HAR fixes worked).
dissenting_concerns: tactical-queen: 19 ACs is tight for 14-day cycle. Mitigation: per-wave commits + Wave 3 HAR fixes are mostly S-effort.
architect-agent: AC-5 phase exit predicate complexity. Mitigation: new audit_resolution_complete predicate kind in phase-predicates.sh.
